# Phase 3d summary (generated by `experiments/phase3d.py`)

Summary written at commit `8eb4fe6775d82060fa2d45325e6149347242a426` (dirty: False), 2026-11-05T05:02:02+00:00. Runs trained at commit(s) `cc4b32b`, `fc0d2c0`; per-run wall times sum to 160 min (~23 min with 7 workers); this invocation took 0.1 min.

2 memory qubits, Phase 2 data splits, 10 seeds per cell. Gap = test NLL minus the source's own NLL on the same sequences (nats/symbol); a run fails if it crashed, diverged or its gap is >= 0.01.

## Operational metrics of the trained instruments (all runs)

eta = operational strength (0: no information, 1: as sharp as the alphabet allows on 4 levels); TV gain = max over input pairs of the TV distance between outcome distributions; I(R:Y) = mutual information between outcome and a purification of the stationary memory state; 1-F = Banaszek operation infidelity after the best unitary correction per outcome (the uncorrected value is also given). See `docs/phase3d-strength.md` for definitions.

## Task-imposed floor on eta

`p(y|rho) <= lambda_max(E_y)`, so reproducing the source exactly needs `eta >= (sum_y max_h p(y|h) - 1)/(min(Y,d) - 1)`, maxima over the oracle's next-symbol distributions on the test histories (`qmem.metrics.strength_lower_bound`). In the feed-forward layout with shared g, `lambda_max(E_y)` is also capped per outcome: `sin^2 g` for symbol 1 (binary).
